chapters: Jano' ba' jix duu maa'n oi'ñga' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia na ba' kuugalh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu chin gu Jeremiiyas jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ux bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gio gu ux ua'nak bham.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' jix maa bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu chuukug gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' chɨkka cham tu'x jai'ch tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ gu Jerusalem gu Judaa gu chuukug gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' no'x ka't jix duñia' bɨx pai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ pai' u'ua'tɨdham bɨɨx jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu vaakax; gio ba' bɨɨx juana' gu chuukug na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup ɨɨbhidham gu jodai' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' bɨx mi'p xikoolh jix duñia' gu noobh bɨɨx gu ux jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu vaakax bɨɨx tu'x a'bhar gu oi'ñga'n makgɨrxi gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro jix buusñi gu ux gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu tasi' ka't bhaan gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu ux gu novɨ gu Mitriidates gu bhóogɨt jix maa gu ux jix duñia' gu Sesbassar gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix bhai'x gu chuukug jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix toja jodai jix bhai'x gu ux.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ux jix uam jodai jix toja jodai jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨx jix duu gu suudai' gu Sesbassar bɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook gu Babiloonia gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam oidha' gɨ' jix tɨ'ɨ gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu tasi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhaan gu Babiloonia suulh gu Jerusalem gu Judaa maa'n kiicham.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx gu Sorobabeel gu Jesuaa gu Neemiias gu Seraiias gu Reelaiias gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Bilsaan gu Mispar gu Bigbai gu Reum gu Baana; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paros gook jix bhai'x chamaam gu vaak gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias vaik gu vaak gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ara gu chuukug gu vaak jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Paat-moab gu ma'nkam gu Josuee gu Joab gook jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sattu gu suudai' oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sakâi gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bani gu bhóogɨt oo'm gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bebai gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asgad jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adonikam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bigbai gook jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Adin gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx maakobh.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Besai vaik gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jora chamaam gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu asum gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gibbar gu oi'ñga'n jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bet-leem chamaam gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Netopa mambhɨɨx gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Anatot chamaam gu ñi'ook gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asmabet oo'm gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n gu Kepira gu Beerot gu chuukug oo'm vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rama gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Mikmas chamaam gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ gu Bet-el gu ai gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Nebo mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Magbis chamaam mambhɨɨx gu ux.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Elam jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arim vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lod gu adid gu Ono gu chuukug gu ñi'ook jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jerikoo vaik oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Senaa vaik jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jedaiia gu vaak gu Jesuaa gu suudai' gu vaak vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Immer jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Pasur jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n oo'm kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu arim jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' gu Lebitas; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jesuaa gu Kadmiel gu ma'nkam gu Odobiias gu vaak maakobh.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asap chamaam gu ñi'ook gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu duukam; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sallum gu ma'nkam gu Ater gu ma'nkam gu Talmoon gu ma'nkam gu Akkub gu ma'nkam gu atita gu ma'nkam gu Sobai; mi' dhɨr bɨx chamaam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sia gu ma'nkam gu asupa gu ma'nkam gu Tabaot.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Siaa gu ma'nkam gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebana gu ma'nkam gu agaba gu ma'nkam gu Akkub.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu agab gu ma'nkam gu Samlai gu ma'nkam gu anaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Giddel gu ma'nkam gu Gaer gu ma'nkam gu Reaiia.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Resin gu ma'nkam gu Nekoda gu ma'nkam gu Gasam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Ussa gu ma'nkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Besai.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Asena gu ma'nkam gu Meunim gu ma'nkam gu Nepusim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Bakbuk gu ma'nkam gu akusa gu ma'nkam gu arur.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Baslut gu ma'nkam gu Meida gu ma'nkam gu arsa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Barkos gu ma'nkam gu Sisera gu ma'nkam gu Tema.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Nesiia gu ma'nkam gu atipa.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sotai gu ma'nkam gu Soperet gu ma'nkam gu Peruda.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Jaala gu ma'nkam gu Darkoon gu ma'nkam gu Giddel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sepatiias gu ma'nkam gu atil gu ma'nkam gu chuukug gu ma'nkam gu Ami.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu suudai' gu ma'nkam tu duukam gu Salomoon vaik gu oi'ñga'n gook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu jix tɨ'ɨ gu Tel-mela gu Tel-arsa gu oi'ñga'n gu Addan gu Immer cham jix duñia' gu takarui' gu vaak tattat tu' gu ma'nkam tu' jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Delaiia gu ma'nkam gu Tobiias gu ma'nkam gu Nekoda gu bhóogɨt mambhɨɨx gook.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Barsillai jix bhɨɨ gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Barsillai gu duukam ka't tɨɨgim gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix suudai' duu jix duñia' cham ka't gaagam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook cham jugi tu'x gu oi'ñga'n jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' bɨɨx ka'm gu takarui' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu Urim gu Tummim.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu takarui' maa'n na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ ka't oo'm gook jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham tu duukam jix duñia' kɨɨv jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv; gio ba' ko'kmarak gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' kavaayo jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu ux; gio ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n oo'm jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' jix ai gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jixchamaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk dhɨt ɨɨbhidham tattat na pai' dhuuk tɨɨtɨs gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu vaak na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix búup gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook jix maa gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jixchamaam jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix daa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu duukam gu suudai' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨx gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' kɨɨv tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jɨ'dɨlh jum daa'ñ gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek xibhɨk jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan na ja'p ua'nak ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Moisees gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xoi'kam ko'kmarak ɨɨbhi'ñ gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n jix duñia' bhaan maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jix duñia' gu kutun na ja'p ua'nak maa'nkar tai bhaan gu tanoolh gu ux jix duñia' jurtu'nka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook bɨx gu maa'nkar gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' dɨr maa'n gu tanoolh gu takarui' kɨɨv kua'da' gu bhóogɨt maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gu' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix maa tuumiñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' gu suudai' jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu' gu Sidonios gu Tirios na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu Joppe jurtu'nka' aagak gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gook namkia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem gu takarui' gook kua'da' gu Sorobabeel gu mar gu Sealtiel gu Jesuaa gu mar gu Josadek gu ja'tkam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bɨx gu suudai' tɨbiap gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix dhaas gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix na ba' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu Jesuaa gio gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu Kadmiel gu ma'nkam gu Judaa na ja'p gu duukam gu chio'ñ gu chuukug na ba' gu chuukug duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu enadad gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios mi'x juu'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jix dhaas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jajannulhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Asap bɨɨx gu suudai' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jir bɨx bhai' gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' alabaa'n gu ñi'ook tɨtdada' gu Jawatan Dios am:―Ja'pji; na gu' jix bhai' na gu' na ba' bɨɨx tas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch bhaan gu Israeel; na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jootos gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' mui'x jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas ɨɨbhidham tattat daraa gu suudai' buupui gu vaak gu ñi'ook ñɨi'ñ gu takarui' dhi' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt mui'x jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun.
Jano' ba' cham gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu ñi'ook suanda' gu ja'tkam; na gu' tu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tɨroon bɨɨx ka'm gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Sorobabeel ɨɨbhidham tattat gui'p; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na gu' na ja'p gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan dɨr gu tanoolh gu Esar-addoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ.

Ba' jix aa' gu Sorobabeel gu Jesuaa gu jodai' ɨɨbhidham tattat gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook no'ch gu tas gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu gɨ'kora' gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix duñia' gu noobh gu ja'tkam gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Kiro gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia bɨɨx ka'm gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bhaan jix koi gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu Artajerjes gu Bislam gu Mitriidates gu Tabeel gu jodai' jugi gu ñi'ook gu Artajerjes gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia; gio ba' gu'p gu ñi'ook ka't gu kutun gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Reum gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Simsai gu oi'ñga'n gu o'o gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jerusalem gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes na ja'p gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Reum gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Simsai gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' jugi gu takarui' gu chuukug gu Erkûeos gu Babilonios gu Susankêos gu takarui' gu Elamitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' tas na jix gɨ' gu Asnappar bhaan gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu Samaria gu jodai' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' dhi' bhaan gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes; mi' dhɨr tu duukam baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix tɨ'ɨ tu' no'ch tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu suudai' kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jugi gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ja'tkam ka't gu gɨ'kora' tu' mii' dhɨr kiicham ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' ka't dhi' namki'ñdha' baaso gu duukam cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu kutun cham jir bhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maachim gu gɨ'kora'.

Na ba' na ba' jix duñia' u'uan gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n tattat; gio ba' bakia' u'uan gu jodai' gu chuukug dhi' kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' oidha' gɨ' gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ux dhi' kiicham ka't gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maachim gu gɨ'kora' tu' dhi' kiicham ka't gu jodai' gu chuukug gu jodai' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim cham ka't gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ dhi' gu suudai' gu Reum gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Simsai gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' jugi gu bhóogɨt gu Samaria gu jodai' baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ gu duukam ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ux tu' ka't jix maa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr kiicham gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix kavɨk ka't gu Jerusalem aapi' bɨx baasɨ'n gɨ' suudai' jiim; gio ba' namki'ñdha' baaso gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jano' jix maa gu vaak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n kiicham gu jodai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ux tu' ka't jix maa gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' xoi'kam cham xoi'kam maakam dhi'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu tanoolh na ba' gu duukam gu gɨ'kora'.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' ba' na pai' dhuuk bhaan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Artajerjes ka't jiñkai'ñ vupui bhaan gu Reum gu Simsai gu oi'ñga'n jugi jix bɨɨx duu jix bhai'x gu Jerusalem tɨtda:―¿Aapi' jix duu gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai' gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ jano' ba' tu duukam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix utu'ñ bɨɨx ka'm oidha' tas gook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dariio gu gɨ'kora' gu Persia.
